description: Selection log for the main study dataset (30 tasks, m01-m30).
selection_basis: Tasks were selected based on category coverage and clear specifications. Selection was not based on judge performance. No tasks were excluded.

proposed_tasks.description: count_vowels: count vowels case-insensitively; bug omits .lower()
is_palindrome: case-insensitive palindrome check; bug omits .lower()
count_occurrences: count char in string; bug assigns 1 instead of incrementing
uppercase_first: uppercase first char, keep rest; bug lowercases the rest
replace_char: replace all old with new; bug replaces old with old
double_all: multiply each by 2; bug adds 2 instead of multiplying
interleave: interleave two lists; bug reverses element order per pair
sum_list: sum all elements; bug skips first element via values[1:]
cumulative_sum: cumulative sums; bug appends value instead of running total
rotate_left: rotate left by k; bug rotates right instead
char_frequency: char counts as dict; bug overwrites count to 1
invert_dict: swap keys/values; bug copies instead of inverting
merge_dicts: merge with sum for common keys; bug overwrites instead
most_frequent: most frequent, ties to first; bug uses >= so ties go to last
count_by_parity: count even/odd; bug assigns 1 instead of incrementing odd
find_all_indices: all indices of target; bug breaks after first match
binary_search: binary search; bug uses < instead of <=, misses last element
first_above: first index > threshold; bug uses >= instead of >
is_sorted: non-decreasing check; bug uses >= rejecting equal adjacents
longest_run: longest run of identical elements; bug never resets current
power_of_two: is n a power of 2; bug uses >= 1 so always returns False for powers
ceil_div: ceiling division; bug returns floor division
digit_sum: sum of digits; bug uses > 1 skipping last digit when it is 1
count_digits: number of decimal digits; bug uses > 1 undercounting by 1
is_perfect_square: is n a perfect square; bug overshoots and always returns False
is_anagram: anagram check case-insensitive; bug omits .lower()
kth_smallest: k-th smallest; bug returns k-th largest
has_duplicate: any duplicate; bug skips adjacent pairs
sorted_intersection: common elements sorted, deduplicated; bug skips deduplication
count_even_sum_pairs: pairs with even sum; bug skips adjacent pairs

statement: Selection was based on category coverage, not judge performance. All 30 proposed tasks were included; none were excluded.
